Hi Sergio,

- Hosted baseline per-token and embedding rates (any tiered volume buckets you recommend)

- One-off costs and licensing/infra fees for Private (VPC/on-prem) + typical implementation SLA windows

Hi Eva — thanks for the forecast. High-level answers below; happy to expand into a short one-pager for your RFP. If this looks useful I can also share a detailed spreadsheet.

1) Hosted baseline (common public tiers)
- Text generation: $0.0006 per prompt token / $0.0012 per completion token (hosted baseline, standard model family)
- Embeddings: $0.0004 per 1k dims unit (example: $0.03 per 1k vectors for 1536-d)
- Volume tiers: 0-1M tokens, 1M-10M (5-12% off), >10M (12-20% off) — we price aggressively once committed.

2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools)
- Typical change: unit cost reduces because infra is reserved and scheduling overhead is amortized — customers see ~25-45% delta vs hosted list depending on utilization and burst assumptions.
- Discounts/credits: committed monthly throughput + SLO targets -> blended per-token reduction; additional levers: higher batching, pinned model variants (quantized)

3) Private (VPC/on-prem)
- One-time platform fee + recurring support/maintenance; depends on on-prem hardware choice.
- Typical profile: highest up-front cost (deployment + PKI/KMS integrations) but lowest per-unit at scale when you control infra.

I attached our baseline ratecard worksheet (hosted) for a clear starting point. Proposal: 30-min call Thursday to run your forecast through a hosted vs dedicated vs private model and produce an RFP appendix.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

Hi Eva — following up with the RFP appendix attached and a short negotiated outline based on your forecast and internal alignment. Highlights below; full assumptions in the appendix.

Summary highlights (Albatross forecast, 12mo)
- Hosted baseline (list): prompt $0.0006 / completion $0.0012; embeddings $0.03 per 1k vectors
- Option A: Hosted + volume tiers (no commitment) -> estimated blended cost: ~$88k/month
- Option B: Dedicated (12mo reserved) -> proposed commercial: 30% off hosted blended list at 60% utilization, minimum commit: $55k/month (reserved GPU-hours) -> estimated blended cost: ~$61k/month
- Option C: Private (VPC + customer infra) -> one-time platform & integration: $120k (pilot + KMS/HSM integration) + support fee $9k/month -> estimated blended cost after steady state: ~$48k/month (assumes infra amortized)

Key negotiation levers we used:
- Volume tiers: native hosted tier discounts layered with reserved capacity credits
- Batching / model quantization profile: committed performance targets enable tighter pricing
- Multi-environment routing: suggest Hosted for burst and Dedicated for steady baseline (we provide a blended quote and a failover policy)

Next steps:
1) Appendix attached for procurement (Redwood_Hosted_Dedicated_Private_Appendix_Albatross.pdf).
2) If the commercial looks good I can send a pro forma SOW and DocuSign link for the Dedicated commitment.
3) We can schedule a 30-minute technical alignment (Laura join) to confirm KMS/HSM integration requirements and timeline (typically 6-8 weeks for Private pilot).

DocuSign (pro forma): https://www.docusign.com/links/12345-alfb-sign

Best,
